name: heading
description: A section heading. Levels must form an outline: one h1 per page, then h2 for sections, h3 inside them, never skipping down a level.

level.title: Heading level
level.description: Pages already have an h1, so content added to a page starts at 2.

id.description: Anchor id so links and skip targets can point here.

wcag.notes: Headings are how screen reader users and agents build a page outline (2.4.10 section headings). Keep them short and descriptive.

machine.identify: The element name is h1 to h6. Read aria-level from the tag number.
machine.operate: Not interactive. Use headings to locate sections; most screen readers jump between them with the H key.
